notes.title: Introducing the Fifth Game in Party Pack 11: Cookie Haus
notes.content: [p]Welcome to [i]Cookie Haus[/i]! You’ve been hired as a cookie decorator for a bakery with an odd sort of clientele. Your job is to decorate cookies to their specifications… better than your fellow employees.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Kb0p6mUjApM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You’ll be given a cookie to decorate. That cookie might look like a crescent moon, but the customer has asked for it to look like “America’s Ugliest Dogs.” [/p][p]It’s time to frost. Choose from a variety of colors and frosting sizes. Add some sprinkles for pizazz. Then, give it a title to illustrate your creative vision.[/p][p]Cookie designs will then be shown in matchups with other bakers. Vote on your favorites, and assign kudos to other bakery masterpieces.[/p][p]Ready to start your shift? Well, the bakery isn’t open just yet. Add [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] to your wishlist on Steam to be first in line at this cursed cookie consortium. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/" style="button"]WISHLIST PARTY PACK 11[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Fourth Game in Party Pack 11: Hear Say
notes.content: [p]Ahhhh! Ahhh. AAAAAAAAHHHHH. AHHHHHH!!!!!!!! Aaaahhhhh. [/p][p][/p][p]Oh, don’t mind me. I’m just warming up my pipes for a game of [i]Hear Say[/i], the fourth game in [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i]! Watch the teaser video for [i]Hear Say[/i] below.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hv7eLDfQlmE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In [i]Hear Say[/i], you’ll be putting your pipes to work to create hilarious soundscapes. Use your phone as a controller, just like all Jackbox party pack games. But in this one, you get to use the microphone on your phone to get real sound effects that work in the game![/p][p]First, you and your friends will need to calibrate. You’ll be tasked with something simple like: get this dot above the line as many times as possible using just your voice. [/p][p]Then, you’ll receive prompts on your device. Something like: “make the noise of a balloon deflating.” If you’re playing in the same room as friends, or in an extra vivacious Discord server of mic-on players, be prepared for a ridiculous cacophony of sound! Record your sounds amidst the chaos or find a quiet spot in the corner to surprise everyone with your funny foley work.[/p][p]After everyone has recorded their sounds, they’ll be played back for everyone to hear and vote for their favorites. Once winners of each round have been selected, those sounds will be presented in a brand new context. That balloon deflating? Now it’s breaking the silence in a peaceful yoga studio.[/p][p]The beauty of this game? Anyone can be a star — from your most charismatic buddy in the group chat to the shyest friend at the function. [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/" style="button"]Wishlist The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/url][/p]

notes.title: Introducing The Second Game in Party Pack 11: Doominate
notes.content: [p]You’ve been good, haven’t you? That’s why you deserve a little treat. You deserve some more information about the second game in Party Pack 11 (coming this fall… see the announcement [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/jackbox-direct-2025"]here[/url]).  [/p][p]Well, since you’ve been so good, we can tell you that this game is called Doominate. Sounds nice, doesn’t it? Oh, you don’t think a game with the word “doom” in it sounds nice? You might be onto something.  [/p][p]You see, in Doominate, you’re going to take something nice and mess with it 😈. It’s a twist on some of our classic joke writing games because instead of answering a prompt, you are building a narrative and trying to make your friends laugh by spoiling some of their favorite things.  [/p][p]Was your favorite thing wrecked by a friend? Don’t worry. In the final round, you’ll have an opportunity to attempt to un-wreck something.  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="HVikLkT9llY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]How many people can play Doominate?[/b]  3-8    [/p][p][b]Around how long does one game of Doominate take to play?[/b]  20 min     [/p][p][b]Will Doominate work with the Jackbox Megapicker?[/b]  If you are playing on Steam, all games in Party Pack 11 will work with the free Megapicker.[/p]

notes.title: How to Play Drawful 2 Remotely
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/jackboxgames/sale/jackboxwinter][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33030169/551be633a0bd5f38741e4c05f637a9f938490464.png[/img][/url]
 

 Are you looking for ways to connect with a friend in a different city? Are you tired of only talking to your pet all day? Want to replace that weekly call home with Drawful 2?
 

 Congrats! You’ve found the perfect blog post. Jackbox Games are local multiplayer games, but with a few extra steps, it’s easy to get a game started with others in remote locations.
 

 If you’re unfamiliar with our games, our general How To Play page is a great place to learn how to start a room and connect players to a game. After you’ve checked that out, hop on back to this page!
 

 [b]Playing with Friends and Family[/b]

 If you feel confident about your internet connections, just jump onto a videoconferencing service (like Zoom, Discord, or Google Meet). Start a game on your laptop and use the screen-sharing option so that your players can see the game. Everyone can play along on their own mobile devices by using a browser and going to Jackbox.tv. If you’re having difficulty getting back to your video conferencing screen from the game’s full-screen mode, go to the settings in the main lobby and turn off “Full Screen Mode.”
 

 If you’re a Steam fan, you can skip the videoconferencing step and use [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam Remote Play Together.[/url] This feature allows you to share your local co-op games online with friends. Using Remote Play Together, only one person needs to own a copy of a Jackbox Games title. Up to four players (or more with faster internet connections) can join.
 

 Discord screen sharing can also be a great option if you’re playing on a laptop. You and up to nine of your Discord friends can connect and have both the game and video-enabled. You’ll want to see your friends’ faces when they’re laughing at your responses in [i][url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jackboxgames.com%2Fgames%2Fthe-jackbox-party-pack-10%2Ftee-k-o-2]Tee K.O. 2[/url][/i].
 

 Some consoles also have screen share or co-stream abilities as long as you’re playing with someone who also owns that platform. Instead of streaming, many people have set up an additional webcam in front of their TV as an easier option.
 

 You can stream using many different platforms, but we generally recommend using a PC to stream over a video conferencing service such as Zoom or Discord.
 

 When sharing these ways, we recommend wired internet connections when possible!

It’s the biggest Party Pack yet, including the return of the classic pop culture trivia mash-up YOU DON’T KNOW JACK: Full Stream; the game of hilarious hypotheticals Split the Room; the lyric-writing, robot rap battle Mad Verse City; the inventive drawing game Patently Stupid; and the outer space fling-fest Zeeple Dome. Use your phones or tablets as controllers and play with up to 8 players, plus an audience of up to 10,000!

Play tonight: https://store.steampowered.com/app/774461/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_5/
